title: Gina R NDE 3113
content: It was 103 degrees outside and I was lucky to be wearing jeans this 25th day of June, 2003. I was leaving a friend's apartment and planned to cut across an eight lane road. It had dividers so I wasn't that worried. Apparently, my timing was off and so was the driver that hit me. All I remember is that I had gotten to the middle divider and stepped halfway up before I felt a force pull me into a direction leaving me in the dark momentarily. A car going forty-five mph struck my body and I could sense the projection occurring before it happened. I could protect myself throughout the accident while learning I could see myself being pulled to a safe place. I don't know where I went just before I got hit. That is why I feel an angel of some sort was also involved. While lying on the hot burning pavement, some people tried to help me and all I could see was how my life flashed in front of me an image of me not walking and of dying in the hospital. While in the hospital, I felt I was in a deep sleep from the exhaustion and impact of the accident but really the morphine was working too. I developed pneumonia in one lung and was getting worse. I was in an unconscious state and then in and out of consciousness. I was without food too. I managed to connect my broken cell phone and call out for help. I thought that I'd heal faster at home and did. The doctor said I might not walk for at least three years and I was walking by one year.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death . I think I flew about fifty feet. I landed on my tailbone/back after rolling up on her hood and windshield. People don't normally survive being hit at forty-five mph while crossing the street.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Darkness | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Upon leaving my body just before I blacked out and the car hit me did I feel I was at my highest level of consciousness and alertness.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: I had a pulling force associated with darkness. I had peripheral vision and outside of that I could see phenomenon happening.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I could sense the loudness of traffic intensified and smells too.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes But it was dark and 103 degrees of sunlight was shining down on me.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes It was an angelic presence that was there to help save me.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain Upon waking up I did see light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I went someplace protected and nice on a beautiful level and when I awoke it was as if I wasn't injured.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I did not know what happened because the lights went out but afterward I felt tired and alert. I felt the burden of healing and how long it would take.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I learned to have more patience crossing the street.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Keenly, I could see myself on the hospital bed and walking on crutches.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I have faith. God is Love in the Highest Power and Creator of everything. He is my Savior Lord Jesus Christ.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes Some of my family and friends feel sorry for me and my left leg has a deformity to it.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I was on psychotropic medication. It was as if my body knew I was about to be struck by a vehicle while crossing the street. I blacked out just before it happened and didn't feel a thing at first. She was going forty-five mph and it didn't even phase me. My first reaction was to get up as if I had just fallen down.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I have some limited ability of telepathy and have tried telekinesis. I have REM (rapid eye movement) too.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I feel I would have hurt more or died if I hadn't been levitated or forced into a dark funnel.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes About a month later I remember running into my teacher who told me that people don't survive the accident I was in. He was astonished of my survival. Some people have a hard time believing me and I sound like a fib teller.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. My experience was definitely real and I viewed it as being special to survive since not too many people come out alive. I suffered only a broken lower leg.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. My experience was definitely real and I currently feel that I am not alone in the sense of angelic beings existing to help me survive.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes I was taking psychotropic drugs at the time which could have affected my judgment and I believe I had a type of heat stroke from not enough fluids while taking Lithium.
